definition: sudden fear when you notice danger
description: A green jungle with hanging vines and sunbeams coming through the leaves. A young woman with long box braids, in a lime crop top and white linen trousers, sits in a white rope hammock with her hand on half a mango on a leaf. She freezes with wide, frightened eyes, staring up at a bright green snake coiled around a branch above her head as it moves slowly. She pulls her hand back, presses it to her chest and grimaces nervously.

taps.phrase: to lie on a green leaf

en.question: What is the woman looking at?
